comparison.objective: Extract four metal fragments from beside a movable artery without injuring it; candidate commissions an industrial-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Precision grasping and collision avoidance in a confined wound versus tool insertion, collar tuning, counterholding, locking, and machine-cycle actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Fragment removal with artery-contact penalties and zero on severe disturbance versus two bounded stopping cycles with no bottoming, overload, rebound, drift, or unsafe energized adjustment. Exact fragment-clearance thresholds are not supplied.
comparison.reason: The objectives, contact risks, manipulated mechanisms, and terminal states are meaningfully unrelated despite both requiring careful contact control.
